name: Covering Fire
text: Choose one ally within Close range and one visible enemy within Far range. The ally moves one range band toward cover. Until the movement ends, the Keeper cannot spend Fear to take the Spotlight to attack that ally.

name: Breach and Clear
text: Open an ordinary door, hatch, window, or light barrier within Very Close range, then move through it. One willing ally may follow. Both gain Advantage on the next attack or Instinct Roll before the next Spotlight.

name: Controlled Withdrawal
text: Choose one willing ally within Close range. You and that ally move one range band away from the current threat. The ally does not use their Spotlight.

name: Weapon Transition
text: Switching to another equipped weapon does not use your Action. If the current action has not resolved, complete it with the new weapon.

name: Planted Stance
text: When an effect would make you Prone or move you against your will, ignore that effect.

name: Casualty Extraction
text: Move one willing, Incapacitated, or Dying ally within Close range one band with you. If the Keeper spends Fear to attack either of you during the movement, that attack has Disadvantage.

name: Anchor the Line
text: When an effect would make you or allies within Close range Prone or move them against their will, you and all affected allies within Close ignore both effects.

name: Tactical Reposition
text: Choose up to two willing allies within Close who can see or hear you. Each moves one range band without using their Spotlight.

name: Suppression Order
text: Choose one visible enemy within Far range. Its next attack before your next Spotlight has Disadvantage.

name: Establish Fire Lane
text: Designate a line within Far range. Until your next Spotlight, each enemy crossing it becomes Vulnerable until the end of its next Spotlight.

name: Safe Restraint
text: After a successful Melee attack, deal no damage and apply Restrained instead, if the target can be physically restrained.

name: Controlled Disarm
text: After a successful Melee attack against a held weapon, deal no damage and force the target to drop it within Very Close range.

name: Evacuation Corridor
text: Move up to three willing non-combatants, or one Incapacitated or Dying ally, one band toward an exit or cover. They have Advantage against hazards and Keeper attacks made after spending Fear have Disadvantage during the movement.
